title: I am in love with a soap dispenser!
text: I am in love with a soap dispenser!. Beautiful soap dispenser. Matches perfectly in my Moen brushed nickel fixtures bathroom. Larger than I was expecting, I think I would have liked it a tad smaller (just because I feel I may have to keep it filled up most of the time because of it's crystal clear see-through glass), but outside of that it's perfect. Well made construction, pumps perfectly and beautifully smooth in design. No complaints, just wonderful for any brushed nickel designed kitchen or bathroom.

product_metadata.title: iDesign Soap Dispenser Pump, The Clarity Collection – 10oz, 2.5" x 3.75" x 6.08”, Clear & Brushed Nickel
features: REUSABLE SOAP DISPENSER: The iDesign Clarity Liquid Soap Pump provides a better alternative to single-use plastic bottles and is made for use with any brand of hand soap, dish soap, lotion, or hand sanitizer. Ideal for bathrooms, kitchens, & more.
EASY TO REFILL: The bathroom soap pump features a wide-opening bottle for easy refills. Simply take off the pump and pour in hand soap, dish soap, lotion, or hand sanitizer.

DURABLE & STYLISH: Made of durable BPA-free clear plastic with a stylish rust-resistant brushed silver pump head, the clear surface of the soap pump lets you easily see when it’s time to refill and matches a variety of home and bathroom décor styles.
EFFICIENT SIZE & 10OZ. CAPACITY: Measuring 2.5" x 3.75" x 6.08", the sink soap pump has a 10oz. capacity. It is ideal for use in compact spaces on countertops.
IDESIGN: iDesign strives to bring organization, innovation and style to your home with a wide selection of storage and organization products to enhance your living.
description: Add a touch of style and functionality to your sink with the iDesign Clarity Collection Soap Dispenser. This reusable soap pump provides a better alternative to single-use plastic bottles and is made for use with any brand of hand soap, dish soap, lotion, or hand sanitizer. The versatile design can be used in the bathroom, kitchen, laundry room, and more. To refill the hand soap dispenser pump, simply take off the pump and pour your favorite liquid soap, lotion, or hand sanitizer into the wide-opening bottle. Made with durable clear plastic with a stylish brushed nickel pump head, the clear surface of the dispenser lets you easily see when it’s time to refill. Measuring 2.5" x 3.75" x 6.08" with a 10 oz. capacity, this refillable soap dispenser is ideal for use in compact spaces on countertops. With iDesign, you can live simply every day.
